_comment: Vendor- or community-reported Blackwell throughput measurements for models InferenceX has not benchmarked. Shown on the page next to the
estimate for that model as a cross-check; NOT used in the arithmetic (single configurations, single sources, different caching and
harness conditions). Units: output tokens/s per GPU system-wide, at the stated interactivity.

points.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
points.note: Single-GPU run; the 1,024-input point at concurrency 16 gave 1,030. No methodology or raw data published.

points.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra
points.note: NVIDIA benchmarking its own model; agentic 64k/400 trace with 90% cache hit gave 311 at 81 tok/s/user. Caching on, so not comparable to InferenceX's caching-off ceiling.
